name: Bullet hit (wall)
description: A bullet strikes a wall: a sharp puff of dust and chips that thins out, leaving a small chipped hole.

looks.text: A close view of a bullet impact: pale dust and chip detail only, no flame.

prompt.subject: a bullet impact (a puff of wall dust, no flame) on {where}
prompt.timing: a bullet strikes {where} at {impact}, its dust thins by {dust} and only a small chipped hole remains at {damage}
prompt.action: At {impact} a bullet strikes {where}: a sharp puff of pale grey dust and small chips of the wall bursts out at full real-time speed, with no flame, no fire and no sparks, hangs for a moment and thins out, leaving a small dark chipped bullet hole that stays.
